Flagrant animal abuse. They are keeping hamsters in pairs on display for sale. Hamsters should not be in pairs for their safety. They are highly territorial and often kill Maime or otherwise harm one another, even if they seem to get along when very young it's only a matter of time and they can turn violent to one another any second. I've attached photos. This is a common practice and animal abuse. It's bad enough how small their cages are and how they sell and advertise undersized cages. But this is taking the mic.

I visited to buy some aquarium fish and selected 3 pairs, planning to get a 4th pair as well. Unfortunately, the lady staff who served me seemed to be in a rush and told me they don’t sell fish after 3:30pm on Sundays, even though it was only 3:45pm and the store closes at 4pm. She had already caught 3 pairs for me, and it would have only taken a minute to catch one more pair, so it felt a bit disappointing and unhelpful.

The other staff members were good and friendly, and the guy at the till was especially polite, well-mannered, and very welcoming, which made the overall experience better.

I hope customer service can be a bit more consistent, as I do like the store and the rest of the team were great.

We arrived at the Kirkstall Pets at Home store with a cat we had rescued.
The sales staff were so lovely and took time to give us loads of advice about cat carriers and how to get a cat into one. We then had a drop in appointment to check whether he was chipped. He had been chipped and the receptionist contacted the family, who wanted to see him before they decided what to do. We were offered hot drinks while we waited for the family to turn up. The lady on reception was very sympathetic and sweet. The family didn’t want him anymore so we made an appointment for a health check before neutering. Unfortunately Monty
went on a walkabout and we had to cancel.
He returned and the male receptionist was very understanding and booked us in again. What a lovely place with lovely staff. ❤️

Took our cat for minor surgery, and they were really professional and kind. Told us straight what needed doing. No confusing word salad followed by an extortionate bill, and of course, we all pay because we love our pets. These guys explained the situation, how much it cost, and even liased with the insurance company so we didn't have to.
